journeys.measurement: Measure visible selection and saved-draft return feedback after keyboard activation in normal and reduced-motion contexts.

composition.observation: The four-choice entry uses a spacious desktop grid and stacked mobile cards; the editor separates passage library, flow, and inspector.

hierarchy.observation: The large entry heading leads to the manual action; the editor foregrounds draft title, Details, and save status.

typography.observation: Serif headings, sans-serif explanations, and labeled controls remain readable at the captured desktop and mobile sizes.

spacing.observation: Choice cards have usable breathing room while the narrow editor toolbar wraps into distinct rows without overlap.

controls.observation: Manual creation, title rename, Chronicle Details, Save details, and Studio return are discernible; unavailable paths say Coming soon.

contrast.observation: Cream body text, gold primary actions, and status text remain legible against the dark teal editor and cards.

consistency.observation: The creation entry, editor, and returned Library retain the Studio shell, palette, account control, and draft vocabulary.

states.observation: The capture shows creation choices, a real untitled editor, saved details, and the named private draft in Library.

responsive.observation: The entry cards stack on mobile, toolbar controls wrap, and the saved confirmation remains within the mobile viewport.

keyboard.observation: Protected traces demonstrate Tab and Enter activation through creation, save, and return; the forward-only route is lengthy.

focus.observation: Visible focus outlines track the active controls; the protected trace reaches Close and Studio by forward Tab, while a shorter Escape route is local-only proof.

feedback.observation: Saved at is visible beside or below Save details within the viewport in desktop and mobile, normal and reduced motion.

motion.observation: Normal and reduced-motion traces reach stable editor and saved states; manifest feedback measurements are about 117 to 207 milliseconds.

continuity.observation: Manual creation opens the real editor, return shows the named private draft with its saved description, and the creation entry remains reachable.

complexity.observation: Manual entry requires no setup form; the mature editor is dense on mobile but keeps controls sectioned and named.

role-outcomes.observation: The Creator can begin manually, edit and save details, and find the named private draft in the Library.

fallbacks.observation: Manual creation remains available while AI, adaptation, and whole-Chronicle template intentions are presented as Coming soon.

findings.observation: The previous protected capture placed mobile reduced-motion Saved at feedback below the viewport after Save details; the current capture shows that confirmation within the viewport.
findings.resolution: The current mobile normal and reduced saved-state screenshots show Save details and Saved at together within the captured viewport.

findings.observation: The protected forward-only trace traverses more than 100 Tab stops from Save details to Close Details and again toward Studio; a shorter Escape and reverse route was verified only in a separate exact-source local probe.

limits: This protected journey shows the draft after Library navigation but does not show a fresh reload, reopen, or subsequent edit.
Semantic browser actions and zero serious axe findings do not establish screen-reader speech.
The shorter Escape and reverse route was verified separately in an exact-source local probe, not in this protected capture.
No physical-device or owner acceptance is inferred.

composition.observation: Three equal desktop workspace cards become a readable mobile stack; destination pages retain distinct task bodies.

hierarchy.observation: All Workspaces introduces the account capabilities and each card names a clear Enter action; destination headings lead their task.

typography.observation: Workspace labels, large serif destination headings, and explanatory sans-serif copy remain readable at captured sizes.

spacing.observation: Workspace cards have useful internal room; focused Creator, Captain, and Player headings sit close to their descriptions.

controls.observation: Enter Creator, Captain, and Player, account disclosure, creation intentions, and Captain tabs have discernible names and states.

contrast.observation: Light text and gold primary actions remain legible on the dark shared frame and destination empty states.

consistency.observation: Shared navigation, account indicator, palette, and return vocabulary persist through Creator, Captain, Player, and All Workspaces.

states.observation: The capture shows available capabilities, empty Creator and Captain workspaces, creation choices, Player empty state, and return.

responsive.observation: Workspace cards stack, Captain tabs wrap, and empty-state calls to action fit the mobile viewport without reported overflow.

keyboard.observation: The protected desktop and mobile traces show keyboard focus and activation across account disclosure, workspace entry, and return.

focus.observation: Visible focus outlines identify headings and actions during navigation; outline spacing at some destination descriptions is tight.

feedback.observation: Available badges, no-content explanations, and Player server-confirmed status explain the captured capability and empty states.

motion.observation: Reduced-motion trace frames show stable transitions among the shared workspace destinations without an observed jarring jump.

continuity.observation: The same synthetic account indicator appears at entry, Creator, Captain, Player, and return to All Workspaces.

complexity.observation: Three capability cards and task-specific empty states make the route understandable without adding a duplicate authoring surface.

role-outcomes.observation: The account reaches Creator Library and creation intentions, then Captain and Player, and returns to the shared workspace entry.

fallbacks.observation: Empty Creator, Captain, and Player states give next actions; all three unavailable creation intentions are marked Coming soon.

findings.observation: Focused Creator, Captain, and Player page-heading outlines closely touch the following description line in mobile captures; text remains readable and the task proceeds.

limits: Visible account continuity does not independently prove canonical identity IDs, capability isolation, or private-resource exclusion.
The capture samples workspace navigation and empty states, not a live Voyage or published Chronicle.
No physical-device or owner acceptance is inferred.
